subject: [PATCH 4/5] mm/gup: return a huge page's full count from follow_page_mask()

2026-08-01.patch_summary: This patch modifies the follow_page_mask() function in the Linux kernel's mm/gup module to return a huge page's full count instead of requiring an additional try_grab_folio() call and subpage loop for large pages. The change involves adding an @end argument, having the huge paths report their count as the return value, and filling every subpage via gup_fill_pages(). This reduces lock contention and improves performance by minimizing the time spent holding a lock, especially for large folios.
